business_description.value: Holori provides a FinOps and cloud infrastructure visibility platform for consolidating, allocating, monitoring, and optimizing cloud costs across providers including AWS, Azure, GCP, and Oracle.

cloud_signals.value: Holori operates a customer-facing software platform accessible through app.holori.com.
The product connects to AWS, Azure, GCP, Oracle, and other cloud providers to visualize infrastructure and consolidate cloud costs.
Holori provides cloud infrastructure monitoring, automated documentation, cost dashboards, allocation, and optimization recommendations.

sales_summary.text: Holori sells a FinOps platform that provides multi-cloud cost visibility, allocation, reporting, monitoring, and optimization recommendations.
Its product connects to major cloud providers and visualizes infrastructure, configurations, assets, and associated costs.
Because these capabilities directly overlap with cloud cost optimization and FinOps services, Holori is classified as a competing service.
